description: This file defines a utility class 'Base64Url' for encoding and decoding data using URL-safe Base64 encoding schemes within the OrangeHRM system. It contains static methods to encode and decode strings, replacing certain characters to ensure URL safety.

classes.name: Base64Url
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for URL-safe Base64 encoding and decoding.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a string into URL-safe Base64 format by replacing '+' and '/' with '-' and '_', and removing '=' padding.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-safe Base64 string back to its original form by replacing '-' and '_' with '+' and '/' and then applying base64 decoding.
